svg.title: Plutto: Western to Vedic, the same sky turned 24 degrees (animated)
svg.desc: Animated square: a natal wheel with the gold orb at its centre appears; its sign ring turns 24 degrees from the tropical to the sidereal zodiac; then the headline and the brand. Ends on a still.

g.text: Western to Vedic: the same sky, turned 24°.
